degree_rationale: The Twelve Judges sent forth by Greatness — First Man, Living Spirit, Mother of Life, Beloved, Great Builder, etc. Essence-completion: judges are the executive ultimates of celestial wisdom.
direction_rationale: The celestial powers placed in their judging stations — settled, executive, completing the celestial dispensation. West = the work is done and judgment ultimates it.
grand_man_function: Celestial executive judgment — the ultimating-of-love into verdicts.
title: The Twelve Judges sent forth from Greatness
